Born in Maryland in 1735 to a German family; farmed in Germany Township, York (now Adams) County,
near Littlestown. A Revolutionary War patriot, recognised by the Sons of the American Revolution.
Died in 1797 and is buried in Union Township, Adams County.
Born on 21 June 1740. She is recorded as Anna Barbara at her son Adam’s 1764 baptism,
and as Maria Barbara on her stone. She married Johann Jacob Winteroth in 1762 and farmed with him in Germany Township,
near Littlestown, Pennsylvania. Widowed in 1797, she died without a will on 18 February 1818,
“Alter 77 Jahr”. She shares his German-lettered stone at Christ Reformed Church,
